messages:
Alex P.: handing off — I'm oncall for the next 8h. quick FYI: we have a hotfix + small DB migration tonight. Details below. :wave:

Alex P.: Hotfix deploy at 02:30 UTC to patch tokenization edge-case in text-gen model (low-risk code change).
- DB migration (online schema change) scheduled at 03:00 UTC, will add nullable column + index on embedding_jobs (no backfill).
- Expected impact: short write latency spikes (~5-10s) while index builds, read paths unaffected.
- Freeze window: 02:15–04:00 UTC — please avoid unrelated deploys.
- Watchers: Maria (canary), Jen (monitoring/metrics), Samir (rollback lead).
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/db-migration (follow steps 1–6).

Maria G.: ack. I can be on canary at 02:25 and will run smoke + a few prompts. tagging @Jen K. for dashboards. :eyes:

Jen K.: noted — I'll wire up an extra alert for 99p latency and error rate spike >=2% for 10m. will post dashboard link ~15m before deploy.

Samir R.: rollback plan in short: if we see >3% 5m error rate or total token timeouts increase x2, flip feature flag `ff.db_migration_read_only` then coordinate DB index drop. I have the scripts staged in staging-cluster.

Alex P.: smoke tests for post-deploy (run after canary passes):
```
# health
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.local/v1/health | jq .status
# quick generation check
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}' | jq .choices[0].text
# check serving pods
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=serving --tail=200
```

Maria G.: copy. I'll run the generation check and post outputs in this thread.

OpsBot: Scheduled deploy: hotfix (02:30 UTC) by alex-p | DB migration (03:00 UTC) by samir-r. Notifying watchers: maria-g, jen-k.

Jen K.: small gotcha — the new index can cause degrade on replica lag for ~1–2 min in worst-case. I've set replication lag >10s alert. If that fires, hold on canary promotion and ping me.

Alex P.: good catch. we'll keep canary at 10% traffic for 15m before promoting. if everything stable, promote to 50% at +30m.

Samir R.: I'll be on standby for rollback steps. FYI, if we need to drop the index quick: `psql -c "DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_embeddings_job"` (risk: will block if not concurrent). prefer `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY`.

Maria G.: sounds good. I'll be in the channel at 02:20 for handoff and will post a final ok at 02:28. :thumbsup:

Alex P.: thanks — leaving notes in the runbook and pinning the smoke commands. ping me if you need escalation: pager duty -> oncall-sre. I'll update this thread with canary results.

Jen K.: acknowledged. will update dashboard link here when alerts are live.

Samir R.: thanks — I'll join voice at deploy time. :phone:

Alex P.: sign-off for now — handing over. :white_check_mark:
